title: adapter.caps@1
description: What an adapter can do, every flag present: delivery and gates choose a route from these, never from the agent's name.

holdStop.description: A stop can be held until checks finish.

wakeIdle.description: An idle session can be woken with an answer.

steer.description: Words can reach a running turn.

followUp.description: A follow-up can be queued for after the turn.

answerPermission.description: A permission request can be answered.

nativeTools.description: The agent's own tool calls are seen by kind.

mcp.description: MCP calls are seen with their server and tool.

rewrite.description: A command can be rewritten before it runs.

editInput.description: A permission reply may carry edited input.

errorTurnHook.description: A turn that ends in an error runs a hook.

startTurn.description: A hook can start a turn.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of adapter.caps that adds a flag
